per_eval.notes: Without skill missed third-party API costs (Anthropic, Google Places)
Both performed well on cost forecasting. With-skill had more precise per-step math and implementation-specific recommendations.
Without skill missed API Gateway v1→v2 migration (biggest win) and Anthropic model selection. Incorrectly suggested switching DynamoDB from on-demand to provisioned (risky for unpredictable traffic).

analyst_observations: The skill's biggest value-add is in cost reduction recommendations — it consistently surfaces Spot-specific optimizations (API Gateway v1→v2, Anthropic model tiers) that generic knowledge misses.

The without-skill baseline incorrectly suggested switching DynamoDB to provisioned capacity, which could cause throttling for a startup with unpredictable traffic patterns. The skill correctly avoids this recommendation.
Both configurations performed equally well on the forecasting task (eval 2), suggesting the skill's cost forecasting framework is useful but not strictly necessary for well-scoped questions.
The skill adds ~6 seconds and ~4,800 tokens of overhead per run — acceptable for the quality improvement.
